balls.text: done and dusted, ends the innings with a yorker that uproots Avesh's off stump, LSG have been dismissed for 146 ..and slow pitch or not, they seem terribly under-par against RCB's line up.
Jitesh has missed the stumps! Rathi missed the slower ball outside off and they steal a bye, Avesh would have been out by a mile had Jitesh hit with his under arm throw
another slower one outside off, Rathi swings and hits the ball firmly to Rasikh's left, he dives full length and makes the save
slower delivery wide outside off, Rathi is beaten

what a reply from Rasikh, nearly in the blockhole and bang on target, threading the gap between Mukul's pads as he shapes to flick on the leg side and misses, that swung back into the right-hander and crashed into the stumps
the slower ball has disappeared over the long-on boundary! Mukul spots the change of pace, waits and then swings hard, making great contact with the fuller length
short of a length outside off, Mukul cuts to the fielder on the deep cover boundary
short of a length outside off, Avesh has a swipe at it and mis-times it towards mid-on

the stumps have been splayed first ball! Bhuvi delivers the perfect yorker at the base of off and middle stump, Shami is rooted to his crease and swings, off and middle stump are knocked back ... Bhuvi on a hat-trick

another superb catch, this time by Tim David running back and to his left from deep third! Linde carved a short of a length ball, using the width on offer to free his arms, he hit it extremely high but not far enough to evade David
yorker on middle and leg, Mukul whips it through square leg
lofted down the ground but Shepherd can't get to it in time running to his right from long on, he dives forward to stop the ball from going past him though
short of a length, cramping Linde for room and time, he gets hit on the thigh as he tries to swing the ball on the leg side, Hazlewood is done for the night and has been superb once again for RCB
fuller length on a wicket to wicket line, Linde clears his front foot and chips it back over the bowler's head
whoa! Linde moves a long way outside off to a short of a length ball and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary
backs away toward leg and drives a length ball from leg stump into the covers
fuller ball outside off and coming in towards off stump, Mukul drives on the up to long off
short of a length at the body, Mukul pulls in front of square leg, he has not timed it well so the fielder in the deep - Salt again - had a lot of sprinting to do to get to the ball
strays down leg side with a full delivery, Mukul misses the glance
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Linde plays towards midwicket and the bowler runs across to do the fielding

caught superbly by Salt running in and to his left from the deep square leg boundary! Pant got low and whipped a low full toss off his pads, that chance would have fallen short of most fielders, but not Phil Salt. He sprinted in from the boundary edge and dived forward to take a superb low catch
short one followed by a yorker on middle stump, Mukul digs it out through midwicket
bouncer, Mukul gets beaten on the pull, that's way over his head though
pulls the short of a length ball into the gap on the wide long on boundary but the fielder covers good ground to his right and slides to save the four

what's happened there? Dropped at short third! Pant reached for a full and wide ball outside off and opened the face late to slice the ball hard and flat to short third, Suyash dived to his left but could not hold on
the slower one dug in short, Mukul pulls and mis-times it towards mid on
full and wide outside off, Pant reaches out for it and tries to slash, takes his bottom hand off the bat ... doesn't make contact

caught behind! Short of a length and very slow outside off, Badoni sees it coming and waits, and tries to upper cut it over the keeper, he can't get enough power behind the shot and Jitesh takes a sharp catch over his head
full toss on the pads, Mukul will feel he's missed out there, clipping it to Shepherd on the long leg boundary
two slower ones followed by a bouncer at 132kph, that surprised Mukul and he ducked under it
another slowie, fuller and straighter, around off stump, Badoni leans into the delivery and pushes into the covers
slower one outside off, but the line is too wide, Badoni waits on it and cuts late, threading the gap between short third and backward point
a bit too short outside off, Badoni goes back in his crease and cuts behind point, that's the end of spin from the RCB attack tonight
bowled flat outside off stump, Mukul stays back and cuts through point, there's a fielder in the deep
gets down on one knee and sweeps behind square, picking out the gap on the boundary
googly on the pads, nudged behind square for a single, Badoni ran into Suyash while he was running the first run, which ended any chance of the second
moves towards the leg side and then back across in his crease to work the ball to wide long on for a quick two
the fast leg break on middle and off, Mukul goes back and punches to long on
flatter and faster on middle, nudged through midwicket for a single
not anymore! Mukul steps out and has the space to swing his arms and makes great contact, smashing the ball far over deep midwicket
defended back to the bowler, what a quiet over so far
pushed to mid on, Mukul wants one an sets off, Badoni sends him back, he gets in safely
really slow from Krunal, shouts of catch it as the batter pushes back to the bowler but it fell well short of Krunal
bowled on a good length and on middle stump, drawing the batter into defending back to him
the googly spins back into the pads, Mukul nudges through square leg for a single
defended back to the bowler

Mukul makes a movement towards leg to try and put the bowler off his line, he then moves back into his standard position and sweeps the flat delivery, getting enough bat on it to go to the fine leg boundary
another googly, Mukul defends this one more watchfully
inside edge saves him, that was flat and fast, like a flipper, Mukul went back to whip the ball on the leg side and got a inside edge on to his back pad
big appeal for lbw as the googly spins into the right-hander and beats the inside edge of his defence, possibly spun too much and a bit high
slowed it up on middle stump, the batter was on the front foot a tad early and had to wait and defend on the off side
wicket to wicket line from around the wicket, pushed off the back foot gently through midwicket and they race through for the second
fired in quicker and straighter, nudged on the leg side for a single
begins with a boundary, getting down on one knee, moving well across his stumps, to paddle the ball fine to the long-leg boundary

another soft, soft dismissal and the slowness of the pitch on show again. Krunal drifts the ball into the right-hander, pitching around leg and drifting down, Samad tries to turn the ball towards square leg but closes the face of the bat way too early, the leading edge loops up for a catch at cover
bowled slowly on off stump, played off the back foot through cover point
dragged down short again but on a straighter line, Badoni punches to long on
tossed up fuller and slower on off and middle, Badoni comes forward and drives towards mid off
finds the gap again this time, going deep into his crease to cut another flat ball to the right of the fielder at backward point
short and wide outside off, Badoni stays back and cuts but can't find the gap at backward point this time
worked off the pads through square leg, into the gap in the deep to take the second
in the air but between the fielders at short third and backward point! Badoni went back to a flat delivery and cut deftly, and placed it well
a more conventional ball to end the over, slower on off and middle, Samad plays it with the angle into him to midwicket

played on! Krunal changes his trajectory, going low in his delivery stride and more side arm, pitching wide outside off ... Marsh tries to force it through the off side and gets a bottom edge on to his stumps
nudged off the pads towards square leg for a single
the bouncer from the spinner again, Badoni is ready and waiting, getting inside the line and pulling it high and far over the long leg boundary
defended on the off side
a loose full toss outside off, Marsh will feel he should have done more with that, smashed the drive straight to deep cover
goes deep into his crease and defends, pushing the ball through midwicket to end the over ... the players are taking a time out.
strays on to the pads, glanced down to fine leg
mis-times the pull to long on, that was a short one but Marsh isn't picking Suyash easily so he's a bit hesitant

huge appeal for lbw but the umpire says not out, and after some confusion between the wickets, RCB decide to take a review. Marsh got down on one knee and tried to swing across the line and missed. He got hit on the thigh but you can see off and middle stump so that might be umpire's call at best on leg stump. It is, so the decision stands.
foxed by the googly! Marsh jabs his bat down at it, looking to play on the off side, that's headed for the stumps until an inside edge sends it just past leg stump
Suyash keeps it on a wicket to wicket line, nudged on the leg side
that's in the slot and Marsh lays into it, lofting with those straight arms to clear the boundary back over the bowler's head
really slow from Krunal, Marsh pushes forward and gets an inside edge near the bottom of his bat towards short fine
bowled extremely wide outside off
dragged down flat and short, Marsh gets down on one knee and nails the slog sweep to the deep midwicket boundary
banged in short by Krunal, and Jitesh does incredibly well to leap up high and collect the ball over his head after Marsh lets it go
moves back and across and nudges the ball towards square leg
makes room by moving outside leg but then has to wait as Krunal slows it down, pushed into the covers
nudged off the pads on the leg side
another pull and another miss, Hazlewood runs his fingers across to deliver a slower one and Marsh swung way too early, the ball goes over his stumps
Marsh signals to the dugout that he's okay after he too gets hit by Hazlewood, that short of a length ball kept a touch low and beat Marsh's pull on the bottom edge, hit him near the box
good length on middle and leg, Marsh stays in his crease and plays off his pads to midwicket
clipped off the pads on the leg side, bit too straight from Hazlewood
what's all the fuss about, says Badoni, standing on his toes in his crease and steering a short of a length ball wide of the fielder on the deep third boundary, got on top of the bounce nicely there

bowled him! LSG are sinking fast in Bengaluru. Hazlewood bowls a similar ball to all those deliveries that hassled Pant, short of a length, pitching in line with the stumps and angling across the left-hander. Pooran tried to pull but didn't have enough room, bottom edge on to his stumps. His miserable season continues
lowest powerplay score for LSG this season and what a venue to do it in, pushed to mid on for a single to end the over
fuller length outside off, Pooran leans into the drive and places it to the fielder at cover ...
banged in short and Pooran ducks under it
a low full toss from around the wicket, on middle and leg, Pooran mis-times it on the leg side
fuller and straighter, close to off stump, driven to long off for a single
slower ball on a good length outside off, Marsh mis-times the cut to point
pitches on a good length outside off and angles away from Pooran who lets it go
gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends
another swing across the line and another miss, this time Pant gets a bottom edge into the ground near his feet
ouch, that's hit him on the left elbow! Pant tried to swing across the line again, this time Hazlewood's line was straighter, and left Pant in some discomfort
whoa! Pant tries to deposit Hazlewood into the midwicket stands with a hard swing at a short of a length ball that zipped across him from over the wicket. He misses
cramps Marsh for room with a short of a length ball angled at the body, mis-times the pull on the leg side

that is quite a bizarre dismissal! It's a full toss outside leg stump, at 136 kph, so not particularly slow. Markram tried to turn it on the leg side and played way too early. The ball may have shaped away just a touch. He got a leading edge that spooned tamely towards cover, he cannot quite believe what's happened as he walks back
slower one on off and middle stump, Marsh spots it and adjusts, dabbing the ball on the leg side for one
pushed off the pads towards mid on for a single before midwicket can cut it off
that's deep in the stands over long-on! Markram stepped out of his crease and simply lofted through the line, dispatching a short of a length ball on the up with a clean swing of the bat
good length, pitching just outside off and shaping in, Marsh angles his bat and steers the ball in front of point
pace-off, on a good length, Markram is standing outside his crease and presses forward to punch past the bowler

that's more like the Marsh we know! He's hit that on to the roof! Bhuvi delivered a knuckle ball to end the over but the length was too short and it sat up for Marsh, who freed those muscular arms and hammered the pull
good length angling in towards off stump, Marsh gets behind the line and blocks
short of a length and slower, grips the pitch as Markram walks forward and punches back to the bowler, that stung Bhuvi's fingers as he fielded in his follow through
clipped off the pads through square leg
fuller ball with swing into the right-hander, Marsh gets squared up again a touch as he plays it back to the bowler
steps out of his crease and punches a short of a length ball to cover

edged again but this time it goes on the bounce to the fielder at short third, who is placed quite fine. Marsh was squared up by one that pitched short of a length, angled into him, and seamed away, drawing the outside edge of his back-foot push
steps forward and towards that short of a length ball and punches on the up towards deep point
strays on to the pads but Marsh is caught on his crease and nudges the ball between midwicket and mid-on
short of a length coming back at Markram from outside off, cramping him for room, he jumps back in his crease and jabs at it, angling the bat to steer towards backward point
brings this one back into MArsh from a slightly fuller length, he clips off the pads in front of square on the leg side

beaten outside the off stump, Hazlewood hits that Hazlewood length, short of a length outside off with some seam movement and extra bounce away from the right-hander as Marsh tries to punch off the back foot
fuller length with some swing away from Marsh as he leans into the square drive to deep point
good length outside off with some shape into the right-hander, Markram moves forward and punches to the fielder at deep cover
clipped off the pads towards midwicket for a single
a fuller ball with width outside off, Marsh drives off the front foot through the gap at cover, not timed perfectly

edged and just wide of Padikkal diving to his right at first slip! Marsh didn't have the room needed to cut that as intended off the back foot and got a thick edge that flew quickly to the third man boundary
good length outside off stump from over the wicket, doesn't come on to the bat all that well, Marsh pushes at the ball and plays to the bowler

that's the game! Shepherd seals victory for RCB by going back and cutting a short ball to the backward point boundary. RCB are on top of the points table, having crushed LSG by five wickets and 29 balls to spare to seal their fourth win in five matches this season
full ball on off stump, driven to long off for a single
slower ball disappears into the crowd beyond long on! Shepherd into the act too, stepping forward and across to drag a length ball from outside off and hammer it with so much power
fuller length around off stump, David drills the ball down to long off with a powerful drive along the ground
length ball outside off, punched off the back foot behind point
pushed to cover point, Shepherd wants one but there's hesitation between the wickets, and a fumble in the field too
played into the covers
cut really hard to the backward point boundary where the fielder sprints to his left and dives but can't save the boundary

oh dear, the relay catch has been messed up on the cow corner boundary! David launched the ball high into the night sky but not far enough, Samad ran to his left on the cow corner boundary and took the catch on the run ... the momentum was taking him over the boundary and so he tossed the ball to Markram, who had run to his left from long on, but he ended up tossing it too far away from Markram for him to complete the catch ...Markram did not seem to be too switched on either
he's swiped hard at that, so hard that it's flown flat and far over the extra cover boundary, hammered it from inside his crease with immense power
tries to play on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad
nudged off the pads towards mid on, the fielder at midwicket runs across to pick up, David sends Shepherd back
googly pitching outside off and spinning in from a good length, David stays back and punches into the off side
yorker on middle to end the over, David digs it out towards cover
moves back and across and nudges the length ball off the pads behind square leg

is that an edge? It is! Two wickets in three balls for Prince as RCB are trying to rush to victory ... Jitesh clears his front foot and swings across the line at a good length ball over off and middle stump, thin edge through to Mukul behind the stumps
looks to play on the off side but gets an inside edge on the leg side

this time he's skied it straight up and the ball lands in Rathi's hands as he runs around from mid-off, PAtidar was aiming to clear the straight boundary but the short of a length ball skidded on to him
RCB are in a hurry to get this done, stand and deliver, Patidar lines it up and swings hard and through the line to clear the long off boundary
Rathi drags his length shorter and Jitesh is ready and waiting, going back to cut in a flash to beat deep point to his left
over deep extra cover again! On the front foot, inside out, getting under a fulling length and lofting it so clean, taking on the fielder in the deep and winning
now he gets inside the line by moving across his stumps and getting down on one knee and slog sweep to the backward square leg boundary
there's a fielder on that wide long-off/extra cover boundary and he's watching the ball fly over his head ... Jitesh made room by moving towards leg and lofted that so cleanly on the up
goes back into his crease to punch the ball along the ground to deep cover
punched to long on off the back foot for a single
moves back and across and works a short of a length delivery through midwicket
short ball just outside off, Patidar gets on his toes and cuts, gets a thick edge between the keeper and short third ... not sure he intended for it to go there but he went hard at it
off the mark by slapping a short and wide ball off the back foot over cover
good length angling into off and middle, Jitesh gets behind the line and defends
jumps back and defends a short of a length ball on the off side

no fifty for Kohli tonight, he's hit this straight to Pooran at long on. He was on the front foot and launched the length ball on the up, just seem to check his shot a bit at the end and didn't get anywhere near the power or elevation needed to clear the boundary .. he walks off after putting RCB well on course for victory.
hit hard off the back foot to long on for a single
nudged towards point and Kohli wants the single, Patidar sends him back, seen a bit of that tonight
backs away towards leg stump to hoick the ball over the off side but mis-times it towards long off
slowed it up on off stump, Kohli punches through cover
dropped a bit short around off stump, PAtidar goes back and cuts hard along the ground to deep point
driven to long off for a single
good length and line on off and middle, played back to the bowler
other side of the ground this time! Shami tests him with a short ball, Patidar gets inside the line on the front foot and pulls the ball over the fine leg boundary
he's absolutely hammered that! It's a pace off delivery on a fullish length, Patidar moves forward and swings with tremendous power, smashing the ball into the first tier of the stands beyond long on
fuller length angling into the right-hander, played off the pads towards midwicket
strays on to the hips with a short of a length delivery, Kohli jumps back and glances to the fielder at deep fine leg to take the Orange Cap from Klaasen
Shami returns and tests Kohli with a sharp bouncer, he tries to hook but gets beaten
slower ball with width outside off, Kohli moves towards the line and punches through point
short of a length outside off, not coming on to the bat, Kohli tries to hit it a bit too hard through the off side and bottom edges into the ground
nudged on the leg side by closing the face to get off the mark

beaten outside the off stump! Great length and line, pitching just outside off and straightening just a touch, Patidar defended inside the line and was beaten on the outside edge, that was really close to off stump too

caught at deep square leg! The short ball from around the wicket angles into the left-hander and cramps Padikkal for room and rushes him for time as he tries to swivel and Pull, a straightforward catch for the substitute Himmat Singh in the deep
short of a length and at the body, Kohli meets it on the front foot and dabs through midwicket for a single
goes on the back foot and pulls a flat ball to wide long on
full ball on leg stump, Padikkal gets down on one knee and slog sweeps to deep backward square leg
nudged into the covers for a much more reasonable single this time

pushes into the covers and sets off for a risky single, Padikkal sends him back, Kohli hits the brakes, turns around and races back, diving to make his ground ... the throw was off the mark in the end
goes back and towards leg and lashes the cut through point
dragged short, Kohli goes back and pulls through midwicket
steps down the pitch and has a swing at a short and slower ball but misses connecting with the pull shot ... the umpire signals for a time out, with RCB cruising
good length angling into the right-hander, punched from the crease into the covers
nudged off the back foot towards point for a single
good length angling into the left-hander from around the wicket, nudged off the pads from the crease towards midwicket
pulled to deep square leg for a single, that kept a touch low but Kohli waited and adjusted
short of a length and wide outside off, grips in the pitch a bit and Kohli mis-times the flat-bat shot past the bowler, mid off has to sprint to his right and dive to cut it off
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Kohli goes back and punches to long off
stays back in his crease and dabs the ball towards mid on
goes back and across and whips the ball through midwicket
pushed down to long on for a single
too short, and Kohli helps himself to the first six of the chase, swivelling pulling the ball over deep midwicket
drags it a bit short but Padikkal can't beat square leg with the pull shot

steps out of his crease to a length ball outside off and takes his bottom hand off the bat as he lofts over extra cover, he hasn't timed it well but once the ball bounces on the practice pitches in the deep it speeds to the boundary
strays down leg side, Kohli misses the glance but Prince will have to bowl that again
short again but the line is down leg side, Kohli swivels to get inside the line of the delivery and pulls wide of the fielder at short fine
Prince goes fuller now, Kohli meets it on the front foot and defends back to the bowler
short ball outside off, Kohli changes direction, punching the ball in the air and over the infield at cover to find the boundary once again
tries to do it again but Prince zips the short ball past Kohli's pull shot on the front foot this time
steps out of his crease and pulls the short ball in the air and over the infield at midwicket, and there's no protection in the deep
played off the pads through square leg for a single
short and wide, Padikkal cuts off the back foot and sends the ball racing to the fielder on the deep backward point boundary
nudged off the pads on the leg side
three in a row, this time Kohli uses the width outside off to free his arms, getting under the fuller length and lofting cleanly over mid off
too short, Kohli has time to move forward and towards the off and pull the ball firmly through midwicket, beating the diving fielder in the deep
strays down leg side, too easy for Kohli who glances off his hips to the fine leg boundary
tries to cut this one a bit too hard and gets a bottom edge into the ground
shot! Simply clips a good length ball with perfect timing off his pads to the square leg boundary
bowled him! That ball skidded through from a good length, keeping lower than Salt thought it might, beating him on the bottom edge and crashing into his stumps as he tried to pull
swish and a miss outside off, Prince is keeping it on a tight line and length
short of a length at the body, Salt pulls the ball in the air through square leg, but did not time it well
played through point for a single

massive mix up in the middle of the pitch as Kohli dabs towards cover point and sets off but Salt wasn't keen ... Himmat Singh came sprinting in to pick up the ball with one hand but failed to do so ... that's a run out chance missed. To be fair, he got a bit of bad bounce there
driven into the covers where Pooran moves quickly to his left and dives to cut off the boundary
Salt has a huge go at that one as it zips across him outside off stump at 139 kph and gets beaten, better line and length from Shami, closer to the batter
short, wide and slapped through cover off the back foot, too much room on offer and Salt cashed in
nips it back into the right-hander this time, cramping Salt for room in his crease, he moves back and plays to square leg
big swing, from both the bowler and the batter, Shami shapes it away from the right-hander from a good length, Salt chases after it, trying to slam it through cover but misses
